status: pinned for review; inference not approved

official_scorer_methods: local meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct behind OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint
repository.scorer_method_note: The pinned official evaluator registers GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, and local Llama 3.1 70B. It uses question-type-specific official prompts, temperature 0, max_tokens 10, and treats any response containing 'yes' as correct. The two API options send question, gold answer, and candidate answer outside the host; the documented local option requires serving infrastructure and a 70B model.

proposed_scorer.rationale: Matches the official README evaluation command and provides the closest comparability to published LongMemEval scoring.
proposed_scorer.label_rule: case-insensitive substring 'yes' in the returned text
proposed_scorer.persistence: Persist only boolean labels and aggregate metrics; do not save scorer prompts or raw responses.
proposed_scorer.approval_status: proposed; external data egress and the full run require user approval

dataset.annotation_policy: has_answer evidence-turn annotations, questions, and gold answers are excluded from compactor input

generation.system_prompt: Answer the question using the conversation history. If the history does not contain the answer, say that it is unavailable.

token_measurements.tokenizer: the pinned model tokenizer with its chat template and enable_thinking=false

compactor_proposal.qualification: DMS-01 and DMS-14 rejected this candidate against their separate decision-model criteria. Its use here is exploratory and cannot reverse those results or admit a production profile.

runtime_proposal.boundary: One in-process local runtime for Von CPU compaction and Qwen MLX reading; no local model server. The separate scorer, if approved, is the OpenAI API.
runtime_proposal.lock_validation: poetry check --lock passed; the isolated runtime was installed under /private/tmp/dms13-py-venvs and its exact package versions were verified.
runtime_proposal.preflight_status: passed for runtime, pinned Von source, 36 GiB RAM, 49.3 GiB free storage, and Metal; run_allowed remains false pending scorer and run approval

proposed_protocol.scoring: Answer accuracy, evidence-turn recall, retained-token ratio, question-type and answerability breakdowns, and runtime/memory. Record cold load time; p50/p95 compaction, answer, and scorer latency; host peak RSS; and MLX peak memory where available. Compare full history and matched-budget recency with model-guided compaction.

proposed_acceptance.primary_budget_noninferiority: paired 95% CI lower bound for model-guided minus recency answer accuracy is greater than -0.03
proposed_acceptance.evidence_noninferiority: model-guided evidence-turn recall is no more than 0.05 below recency
proposed_acceptance.minimum_improvement: at least 0.05 improvement over recency in answer accuracy or evidence-turn recall at the primary budget
proposed_acceptance.full_history_reference: report separately as the uncompressed reference; no admission threshold is assigned

proposed_protocol.approval_status: All protocol values are proposals. The proposed official GPT-4o scorer and exact run configuration require user approval before any model inference.
